statement: Fresh experiment steam-s3-physical-descriptor imports the exact 372-byte physical direct-wired 28de:1302 HID report descriptor and reduced 41-byte USB configuration, with one HID interface and two interrupt endpoints. That descriptor-shape portion of the former gap is now observed; see steam-s3-1302-report-shapes and steam-s3-1302-usb-interface. Residual unknowns are physical feature/probe transactions, field semantics, firmware/revision variation and consumer acceptance; descriptor declarations alone do not resolve those.

applicability.scope: Residual evidence gap only after fresh physical descriptor acquisition. Earlier July observations remain historical, raw-not-revalidated evidence; the new direct descriptor fixture does not establish feature replies, field meanings or consumer behavior.
